senses.definition: adj. speckled;—only of sheep and goats; נ׳ Gn 30:32(×2), fpl. נְקֻדּוֹת v 35 (all ‖ טָלוּא), mpl. נְקֻדִּים v 39 (‖ id. + עֲקֻדִּים;—all these J); mpl. also 31:8(×2) and (+ עֲקֻדִּים, בְּרֻדִּים) v 10, 12 (all E).
